name: Shimmering Specter / Mirage excludes a real seven-power Illusionist attack, through Damage only
printed_text:
While this is attacking or defending, when this leaves the arena, create a Spectral Shield token.

**Mirage**
format_scope: Four manual young Prism1/Prism2/Dori3/4 at20. ActualPotion8/ABI10 funds2; actualHeraldTriumph9 declaresHero2 and pays2/AP1, attacks at7. P2 physically defends with owned Specter5 and Wounds6/7, defense2+3+3=8. Mirage requires a non-Illusionist attack with power6orhigher: this actual7-power attack is Illusionist, so no Mirage is earned. Specter is also Illusionist so cannot earn the attacker Phantasm; GenericWounds have less6power. RealDamage0/allhealth20 with allfourphysicalcards still on currentchain. Test ends strictly in DAMAGE before any further pass intoResolution/Close. Nothing leavesarena, so primaryleaveWHEN is not earned; that known timing route remains untested. Limited keywordclass exclusion, not positive destruction or completed wholecard combat. No engine change.
